title: Checkspan shared primitives
description: Identity primitives reused by every Checkspan record. Schema IDs are identifiers under a reserved, never-resolving host; they are served only by the bundled offline registry.

identifier.description: Stable machine identifier. Lowercase ASCII letters, digits, '_', '.', '-'; must start with a letter or digit; at most 128 bytes. Display names are separate fields and never identity.

schema_version.description: Major version of the record schema. Unknown versions are rejected before any other check.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time with an explicit UTC offset or 'Z'.

display_name.description: Human-facing label. Carries no identity; two records with the same identifiers are the same record regardless of display name.
